* feat(flaky-test-catcher): add classifyRuns and computeGate shared lib

* feat(flaky-test-catcher): add check_ci_failures.inline.js pre-activation script

* test(flaky-test-catcher): add unit tests for classifyRuns and computeGate

* fix(flaky-test-catcher): add status=completed filter and use filterIssues in inline script

* test(flaky-test-catcher): update tests for cancelled exclusion, add filterIssues and boundary tests

* feat(flaky-test-catcher): add workflow template (task 2.1/2.2)

Create .github/workflows-src/flaky-test-catcher/workflow.md.tmpl with:
- YAML frontmatter: daily schedule + workflow_dispatch trigger
- Pre-activation check_ci_failures step wiring
- Engine config (claude-sonnet-4-6, high effort)
- Permissions: contents:read, issues:write, actions:read
- safe-outputs: create-issue (flaky-test + code-factory labels, max 3) and noop
- network: defaults + elastic.litellm-prod.ai (no toolchain needed)
- if gate: has_ci_failures == true && issue_slots_available != 0
- Agent prompt: pre-activation context, skill reference, 8-step execution,
  issue body sections, noop conditions

* fix(flaky-test-catcher): workflow template review fixes

- Add checkout: fetch-depth: 0 for git history access during commit analysis
- Expand noop safe-output to explicit max:1 + report-as-issue:false
- Reframe Commit Analysis step as fix-detection (has it been fixed?) rather
  than regression attribution; include 'may already be addressed in <sha>' note

* feat: add flaky-test-catcher agent skill document (task 3.1)

Creates .agents/skills/flaky-test-catcher/SKILL.md with the complete
analysis protocol for the flaky-test-catcher workflow agent:

- How to use pre-activation context (failed_run_ids, total_run_count,
  issue_slots_available) without re-querying GitHub
- gh api commands for fetching job lists and logs
- --- FAIL: extraction pattern with guidance on handling large logs
- Fail-rate formula and thresholds (broken=100%, flaky>=20%, noise<20%)
- Base-test-name grouping rule (TestAcc[^_]+)
- Commit analysis steps to detect whether failures may be addressed
- Issue deduplication against existing open flaky-test issues
- Required 5-section issue body format with formatting rules
- Noop conditions and summary of execution order

* fix: address review findings in flaky-test-catcher skill and workflow

workflow.md.tmpl:
- Fix Commit Analysis section: remove regression-blame framing,
  replace with fix-detection framing (may already be addressed)

SKILL.md:
- §3.3: add concrete bash example (gh api ... | grep '^--- FAIL:')
- §4: add same-run deduplication note (set per run, not per job)
- §6: add fallback rule for non-TestAcc test names
- §7: add explicit 'do not suppress issue creation' statement
- §8: add pagination guidance for dedup issue query (Link header)
- §9: add explicit cap enforcement check before each issue creation

* chore: add flaky-test-catcher entry to workflow manifest

* chore: compile flaky-test-catcher workflow from template

* chore: mark tasks 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 as complete

* chore(flaky-test-catcher): fix permissions and add compiled lock file

- Change issues: write to issues: read (safe-outputs handles the write)
- Regenerate compiled .md with corrected permissions
- Add flaky-test-catcher.lock.yml from gh aw compile --approve

* chore(flaky-test-catcher): mark tasks 5.1 and 5.2 complete

* chore(flaky-test-catcher): note 5.3 is post-merge verification

- Remove double [flaky-test] prefix from issue title format in prompt and SKILL.md;
  the prefix is added automatically by safe-outputs.
- Update dedup guidance in SKILL.md to check against the full rendered title.
- Fix failed_run_ids example type: numeric IDs without quotes.
- Align issue body heading level: use ## in prompt to match SKILL.md

* fix(skills/flaky-test-catcher): use gh run view --log instead of gh api for job logs

gh api /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs returns a ZIP
archive, which cannot be piped directly to grep. Use gh run view
--job {job_id} --log to stream plain-text logs instead.

Addresses review comment on PR #2684.

  lib/runners/gate.js keyed off a new GATE_NAME env. Each gate spec
  declares its env-var prefix and which lib evaluator to call.

+- Issue title format: `<BaseTestName>` (the `[flaky-test]` prefix is added automatically by `create-issue`).
+
+### Issue title length guardrail
+
+GitHub issue titles are limited to **256 characters total**, including the
+`title-prefix` that `create-issue` prepends automatically.
+
+- This workflow's prefix is `"[flaky-test] "` (13 characters),
+  leaving **243** characters for the title you provide.
+- Before calling `create-issue`, verify that
+  `len("[flaky-test] ") + len(your title)` is **≤ 256**.
+- Continue using the base test name as the agent-provided title. Most base
+  test names fit within the remaining space; if a base test name is unusually
+  long and would exceed the limit, use up to the first 243 characters and
+  place the full name in the issue body.
+- Keep titles concise. Move full file paths, function signatures, attribute
+  lists, failure excerpts, and detailed descriptions into the issue body.
+- Do not include markdown heading markers (`#`), emoji, or the prefix label
+  redundantly in the title. The title field is plain text.
 
 Each issue body must include the following sections (use `##` headings to match SKILL.md):
 
 ## Broken Tests
+
 List the specific test function names (with subtests) that failed in 100% of sampled runs.
 
 ## Flaky Tests
+
 List the specific test function names that failed in ≥ 20% but < 100% of runs, with each test's observed fail rate (e.g. `3/5 runs`).
 
 ## Commit Analysis
+
 Note any commits on `main` since the oldest failing run that appear to address the failure. If a relevant fix commit is found, note: "may already be addressed in `<sha>`". If no relevant commits found, note that explicitly.
 
 ## Sample Failure Output
+
 Paste the most informative `--- FAIL:` log excerpt from the failed runs to give context to the implementer.
 
 ## Affected Stack Versions
+
 List the Elastic Stack versions (Elasticsearch, Kibana) reported in the failing job environment, if discoverable from the logs or job metadata.
 
 ## Noop conditions
 
 Call `noop` with a concise explanation when:
+
 - All affected base tests already have an open `flaky-test` issue (nothing new to open).
 - All test failures are below the 20% fail-rate threshold (noise only, no actionable signal).
 - No `--- FAIL:` patterns were found in any of the failed run logs.
 
 ## Dispatch
+
 After creating all issues for this run (or if no issues were created), call the `dispatch_code_factory` safe output tool once to dispatch the `code-factory` workflow for each created issue.

commits.message:
chore(workflows): bump remaining factory/rotation agents to claude-sonnet-5 (#4298)

* chore(workflows): bump remaining factory/rotation agents to claude-sonnet-5

Update change-factory-issue, code-factory-issue, duplicate-code-detector,
flaky-test-catcher, issue-classifier, schema-coverage-rotation, and
semantic-function-refactor from llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-4-6 to
llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-5.

Also sets max-ai-credits: -1 on each, since the AWF api-proxy has no pricing
entry for the new alias and gh-aw's models.providers frontmatter override
does not currently propagate to apiProxy.defaultAiCreditsPricing
(github/gh-aw#47365, fix pending in github/gh-aw#47571 as of v0.83.1) —
confirmed necessary by testing the same failure mode on the
research/reproducer factories in #4296.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(workflows): align model assertions with claude-sonnet-5

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -22,13 +22,24 @@ on:
           await fn({ github, context, core });
 engine:
   id: claude
-  model: "llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-4-6"
+  model: "llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-5"
   args:
     - "--effort"
     - "high"
   env:
     ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "https://elastic.litellm-prod.ai/"
     ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY }}
+# Disable the per-run AI Credits budget guard. The model alias
+# "llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-5" is a private Elastic LiteLLM alias absent from
+# the AWF api-proxy's built-in pricing table. gh-aw's models.providers
+# frontmatter override does not propagate to apiProxy.defaultAiCreditsPricing
+# (see https://github.com/github/gh-aw/issues/47365, fix pending in
+# https://github.com/github/gh-aw/pull/47571), so with the guard active the
+# proxy rejects every request with HTTP 400 (unknown_model_ai_credits).
+# Setting -1 omits maxAiCredits from the generated AWF config, letting the
+# agent run. The daily guardrail (max-daily-ai-credits, default 5000/day)
+# still applies.
+max-ai-credits: -1
 permissions:
   contents: read
   issues: read
